def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    diff = np.abs(bins - item)
    priority_vals = -diff
    tie_break = bins / (np.max(bins) + 1e-12)
    return priority_vals + tie_break * 1e-9

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    used = bins - (bins - item) * (bins >= item)
    utilization = used / (bins + 1e-12)
    valid = bins >= item
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    scores = item * utilization
    # Penalize invalid bins heavily
    scores[~valid] = -np.inf
    priority_scores[valid] = scores[valid] + bins[valid] * 1e-10
    return priority_scores
